c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.1.evidence: Delete on the membership rule -> confirm 'Are you sure? This cannot be undone.', row removed, toast 'Access rule deleted.'

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.2.expected: the matched subscriber reloads the space -> closed on the next load, no admin action
c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.2.actual: closed for gating_t6, who was never synced (locked card, composer gone). NOT closed for people who were put on the roster with Sync Members: gating_t2 (roster row source 'tier') still posted topic 'Mounting tape or corners for fine art prints?' after the rule was deleted; the row only disappears when the hourly roster reconcile runs.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.3.actual: 403 jetonomy_forbidden 'You cannot post in this space.' for the never-synced gating_t6 (reply and topic); the synced gating_t2 was still accepted (topic created) until the reconcile ran.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.4.evidence: membership lapse: running Membership_Roster_Sync::reconcile() after the rule was gone removed the three 'tier' roster rows (3837, 3838, 3839) and kept the manual row.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.5.needs: a member with bookmarks, subscriptions and notifications from the space; not seeded

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.6.evidence: gating_t5 (manual roster member) kept his row through the reconcile, so a person who is on the roster by hand keeps access.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.7.evidence: gating_t6's topic URL after the rule was deleted -> 404 'Page not available', same page as a missing topic.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.8.expected: no email for new replies in the space after access ended
c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.8.actual: gating_t2 lost the roster row (reconcile) and then got '[forums] varundubey replied to your topic' by email with the reply text 'Thanks for the question, answers coming this week.' and a link into the private space; no bell row was created.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.9.evidence: gating_t6 typed a reply, the rule was deleted from another session, Post Reply -> toast 'You cannot post in this space.' and the text stayed. Screenshot qa-artifacts/203-walk3/laneA/w3A-access-ended-typing.png

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.10.evidence: membership rule re-added (no sync): gating_t6 opened the private topic and had the composer on the next load.
